newsitem.title: UK: Brixton Estate buys site, sells centre.
newsitem.headline: Brixton Estate buys site, sells centre.

text.p: British property firm Brixton Estate Plc said on Tuesday it bought a 3.8-acre site in Woking, southern England, for 2.5 million stg and planned to use the land for an industrial estate.
Brixton bought the site from Swan Hill Developments.

The company also said it sold Redhill Distribution Centre at Salfords to Boots Pensions Ltd for about 5.0 million stg, representing an increase of nearly nine percent over book value at the end of 1996. --London Newsroom +44 171 542 7717
